_comment: Shared by services/api/src/minerva_api/agent/refs.py (COMPONENT_SUFFIX, NO_ID_SUFFIX) and apps/web (provenance-notes.tsx). An entry of a card's unverified_inputs that ends with component_suffix names one row of an earlier card's list; one that ends with no_result_id_suffix is a tool result that has an equation number but no result id; any other entry is an equation the model wrote. Change it in all three places.
component_suffix: , a component of an earlier result

examples.list_component: equation (3), a component of an earlier result
examples.no_result_id: equation (4), a tool result with no result id

no_result_id_suffix: , a tool result with no result id
